records.text: Owens said Baron Coleman drew her attention to a similar, potentially corroborating account by Frank Turek on the Apostate Prophet podcast released April 9th, 2026.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Mostly I'm inclined to believe it, though, because when I mentioned this to Baron Coleman at a separate time, he brought to my attention. ... That a similar and potentially corroborating story was told by none other than Yankin Bankin Frank (Frank Turek). Yes, ladies and gentlemen, Frank Turek, with an ever so slight variation on the story that we heard, rather an excuse for why he did this, has already admitted that he gave his bloodied bag to a police officer to dispose. ... Frank (Frank Turek) has this way of getting ahead of things. Like, you go back, and I was like, I don't remember this at all. Baron (Baron Coleman) said, yeah, he said that recently. The exact date was April 9th, 2026. You can take a listen to what he said. It was on a podcast called the Apostate Prophet podcast. And again, this was recorded, this was released, rather, on April 9th, 2026. Take a listen.
